taiwan_aviation.headline: 民航局宣布明日國內線全數取消 國際航班仍可能調整
taiwan_aviation.summary: 民航局表示，依國籍航空公司最新資訊，明日國內線全數取消，國際航班也可能因颱風持續調整，提醒旅客出發前向航空公司確認。截至今日18時，國內線已有126架次、國際線40架次取消；立榮航空與華信航空今日各加開2架次澎湖航班，以疏運滯留旅客。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan CAA Says All Domestic Flights Will Be Canceled Tomorrow as International Schedules May Change
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan’s Civil Aeronautics Administration said all domestic flights are scheduled to be canceled tomorrow, while international schedules may continue to change because of the typhoon. It urged passengers to confirm their flights with their airlines before departure. As of 18:00 today, 126 domestic and 40 international flights had been canceled. Uni Air and Mandarin Airlines each added two Penghu flights today to move stranded passengers.

sources.name: CAA Taiwan — 颱風逼近，國內線明日全數取消，民航局提醒留意航班異動

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航A350部分航機未提供Wi-Fi 免費上網資格依客艙與會員身分而異
taiwan_aviation.summary: 華航將A350列為提供機上Wi-Fi的機型，但特定航機暫無服務，訂位顯示A350或A359代碼不代表一定能上網。有提供服務時，經濟艙可免費傳送文字訊息；豪華商務艙、豪華經濟艙及指定會員可免費瀏覽網頁，付費方案也僅適用於有Wi-Fi的航機。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines Says Some A350s Have No Wi-Fi, While Free Access Depends on Cabin and Membership
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines lists the A350 as a Wi-Fi-equipped type but says service is unavailable on certain aircraft. An A350 booking or A359 code does not guarantee connectivity. Where Wi-Fi is available, Economy passengers receive free text messaging, while Premium Business, Premium Economy and eligible members receive free browsing. Paid plans also require the aircraft to have Wi-Fi service.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 華航引進前四川航空A350補充廣體運能 B-18920座位圖列331席且三架升級尚未完成
taiwan_aviation.summary: 華航引進前四川航空營運的A350-900，以補充廣體運能；B-18920官方座位圖列出331席、兩艙等配置，與華航原有306席版本不同。華航2026年5月8日公告三架A350客艙設備升級案，但未公布逐架改裝時程或完工日期，不能據此認定相關航機已完成改裝。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: China Airlines Adds Capacity With Ex-Sichuan A350s, While B-18920 Has 331 Seats and Upgrades Remain Pending
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: China Airlines introduced A350-900s formerly operated by Sichuan Airlines to add widebody capacity. Its official B-18920 seat map lists 331 seats in two classes, unlike the airline’s original 306-seat configuration. On May 8, 2026, China Airlines disclosed an upgrade project for three A350s but did not provide individual aircraft schedules or completion dates; the disclosure does not establish that the aircraft have already been refurbished.

international_aviation.headline: 歐洲多國研議擴大關鍵基礎設施業者反制無人機權限 法國已通過相關法律
international_aviation.summary: 歐洲多國正研議讓關鍵基礎設施營運者及承包商取得更大反制無人機權限，部分措施原由國家機關執行。各國仍須釐清應對權限及無人機遭擊落後的損害責任。法國已於8月通過法律，准許業者在指定設施附近偵測、干擾並擊落無人機。
international_aviation.headline_en: European Countries Weigh Broader Counter-Drone Powers for Infrastructure Operators as France Passes Law
international_aviation.summary_en: Several European countries are considering broader counter-drone powers for critical-infrastructure operators and contractors, including measures traditionally handled by state authorities. Governments still need to resolve who may respond and how liability would apply if a downed drone causes injury or property damage. France passed a law in August allowing operators and contractors to detect, jam and shoot down drones near designated facilities.

international_aviation.headline: Saudia與Riyadh Air改由Al Qassim接運利雅德旅客 後續須搭乘免費巴士
international_aviation.summary: Saudia與Riyadh Air將前往利雅德的旅客改由Al Qassim Airport接運，後續公路行程超過四小時；利雅德King Khalid International Airport雖於10月18日重開，仍受營運限制。Riyadh Air於10月22日安排由倫敦希斯洛、馬德里及曼谷飛往Al Qassim的特別航班，旅客可搭乘已含於機票的免費巴士續程，安排仍可能變動。
international_aviation.headline_en: Saudia and Riyadh Air Reroute Riyadh-Bound Passengers Through Al Qassim, With Free Bus Transfers
international_aviation.summary_en: Saudia and Riyadh Air are routing passengers bound for Riyadh through Al Qassim Airport, followed by a road journey of more than four hours. King Khalid International Airport reopened on October 18 but remains subject to operational restrictions. Riyadh Air arranged special flights to Al Qassim from London Heathrow, Madrid and Bangkok on October 22. Passengers can continue by complimentary bus included in the ticket, though arrangements may change.

international_aviation.headline: IATA與OneVasco整合簽證代辦服務 旅客可從Timatic查詢入境要求後申請簽證
international_aviation.summary: IATA與OneVasco宣布，將OneVasco簽證代辦服務整合至Timatic Solutions，讓旅客查詢入境要求後可直接進入簽證申請流程。服務將作為Timatic的補充選項提供航空公司，並整合至Timatic Web及Timatic Widget；Timatic旅遊資訊也將納入OneVasco簽證平台。
international_aviation.headline_en: IATA and OneVasco Integrate Visa Service With Timatic, Linking Entry Checks to Applications
international_aviation.summary_en: IATA and OneVasco announced that OneVasco’s visa concierge service will be integrated into Timatic Solutions, allowing travelers to move from checking entry requirements to applying for a visa. The service will be offered to airlines as an optional addition and integrated with Timatic Web and Timatic Widget. Timatic travel information will also be incorporated into OneVasco’s visa platform.

sources.name: IATA — IATA Partners with OneVasco to Streamline Visa Applications

international_aviation.headline: 亞美尼亞首架L-39 Skyfox現身空軍標誌 訂購數量與交付時程未公布
international_aviation.summary: 亞美尼亞國防部公布的照片顯示，國防部長Suren Papikyan於2026年10月20日訪問Aero Vodochody工廠時，檢視一架帶有亞美尼亞空軍標誌的L-39 Skyfox。他表示飛機很快將在亞美尼亞天空飛行；最多四架可能於未來數週交付的消息尚未獲正式確認，訂購數量及交付時程均未公布。
international_aviation.headline_en: Armenia’s First L-39 Skyfox Appears in Air Force Markings, With Order and Delivery Details Undisclosed
international_aviation.summary_en: Photographs released by Armenia’s Ministry of Defense show Defense Minister Suren Papikyan inspecting an L-39 Skyfox in Armenian Air Force markings during a visit to Aero Vodochody’s factory on October 20, 2026. Papikyan said the aircraft would soon fly in Armenia. A report said up to four aircraft could arrive in the coming weeks, but neither the order quantity nor a delivery schedule has been formally disclosed.

international_aviation.headline: 新加坡航空公布KrisWorld升級 將提供4K OLED觸控螢幕與2,500項內容
international_aviation.summary: 新加坡航空於2026年10月21日公布機上娛樂服務升級，新一代KrisWorld將提供4K OLED觸控螢幕、空間音訊、藍牙配對及2,500項內容。介面也將加入較清楚的選單、改良搜尋功能與迷你播放器；登入KrisFlyer的旅客可取得個人化推薦、航班資訊，並在不同航班間同步觀看紀錄。
international_aviation.headline_en: Singapore Airlines Announces KrisWorld Upgrade With 4K OLED Touchscreens and 2,500 Content Options
international_aviation.summary_en: Singapore Airlines announced an inflight entertainment upgrade on October 21, 2026. The new KrisWorld platform will offer 4K OLED touchscreens, spatial audio, Bluetooth pairing and 2,500 content options. The redesigned interface adds clearer menus, improved search and a mini player. Passengers who log in with KrisFlyer credentials will receive personalized recommendations and flight information and can sync viewing history across flights.

international_aviation.headline: BAE Systems稱TRV-150在佛州試驗單次飛行攔截多架攻擊無人機 未降落或重新裝填
international_aviation.summary: BAE Systems於2026年10月21日表示，TRV-150於2026年9月下旬在佛羅里達州Eglin Air Force Base試驗中，單次飛行攔截多架單向攻擊無人機。這架以Malloy Aeronautics T-150為基礎的武裝無人機使用搭載APKWS火箭的三聯裝發射器，連續接戰期間未降落或重新裝填；攔截及發射數量、目標身分均未公布。
international_aviation.headline_en: BAE Systems Says TRV-150 Intercepted Multiple Attack Drones in Florida Trial Without Landing to Reload
international_aviation.summary_en: BAE Systems said on October 21, 2026, that the TRV-150 intercepted multiple one-way attack drones during a single flight in a late-September trial at Eglin Air Force Base, Florida. The armed drone, based on Malloy Aeronautics’ T-150, used a three-pod launcher carrying APKWS rockets and engaged targets in succession without landing or reloading. The number of drones intercepted and rockets fired, as well as the targets’ identities, were not disclosed.
